name: ココナラ
description:
760種類以上のカテゴリで知識・スキル・経験を売り買いできる、日本最大のスキルマーケット「ココナラ」。AIが予算に合わせた絞り込みを行い、一つひとつの推薦理由を添えて提案するため、比較の手間なく、納得のサービスへ最短距離で辿り着けます。
このアプリは検索とおすすめ機能のみに対応しています。アプリ内課金やサービスの決済には対応していません。

_published_faq.name: How do I add ココナラ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ココナラ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ai-assist.coconala.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is ココナラ MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, ココナラ scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ココナラ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ココナラ provides these MCP tools: csm_search_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ココナラ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ココナラ in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does ココナラ MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ココナラ does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
ココナラ is developed by coconala inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
